## Why

The s298 review (2026-10-16) accepted two small debts. `ops.ledger_lock` copies the flock-and-deadline loop of `store.project_lock`, calls the private `store._lock_timeout()`, and words its timeout message differently, so the two locks can drift. And the `.slicer/` listing in `docs/commands.md` (about line 390) says the legacy ledger is "no longer written in a git repo", but a project below the worktree root still writes it.
